articles.title: 'Not offered with genuine devotion': UP assembly speaker on those claiming their donations at Ram temple were stolen; clarifies remark
articles.description: Uttar Pradesh assembly speaker Satish Mahana linked donation theft to lack of genuine devotion. He stated that those who feel their money was stolen may not have offered it sincerely. An investigation revealed nine major procedural and security lapses enabling embezzlement of temple donations. Eight individuals associated with the donation counting process have been arrested so far.

articles.title: Live-In Relationships And UCC: Madhya Pradesh's Registration Mandate Mirrors 3 Other BJP-Ruled States
articles.description: Madhya Pradesh is not starting from scratch. It is consciously looking at the UCC models implemented in Uttarakhand and Gujarat, and more recently Assam, and then adapting them.

articles.title: India-UK CETA to give fresh momentum to farmers, MSMEs and entrepreneurs, says PM Modi
articles.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Wednesday said the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and the Social Security Agreement mark a major milestone in bilateral ties, strengthening economic links and creating new opportunities for businesses and skilled professionals.

articles.title: ‘Prasoon Joshi has not seen Satluj, but has problems with it’: Anurag Kashyap on film’s ban
articles.description: Anurag Kashyap has revealed that Satluj director Honey Trehan told him that CBFC Chairperson Prasoon Joshi hadn't even watched the film before he refused to clear it for release.

articles.title: ICAI Corporate Mitra Registration 2026 Begins Today; Graduates And Final-Year Students Can Apply Till July 31
articles.description: ICAI has opened registrations for the Corporate Mitra programme from July 15, 2026. The initiative aims to create job-ready paraprofessionals to support MSMEs in accounting, taxation, compliance, banking and financial management. Applications close on July 31.

articles.title: Revisiting the Lakshadweep strategy—How India’s smallest UT got tuberculosis-free status
articles.description: As of mid-2026, no Indian state has achieved TB-free certification. New book explains that Lakshadweep’s achievement did not come through expensive tech or complex interventions.
